text: LPEseq2 R package local pooled error-based ANOVA RNA-seq count data. package provides functions preprocessing RNA-seq count data, estimating intensity-dependent variance trends, performing multi-group differential expression analysis using local pooled error-based ANOVA framework.

text: count matrix contain genes rows samples columns. sample metadata contain samples rows variables columns. column names count matrix must match row names colData.
code: # Example count matrix #        sample1 sample2 sample3 sample4 # gene1      100     120      80      95 # gene2       50      60      55      70 # Example colData #          group # sample1 Control # sample2 Control # sample3 Treatment # sample4 Treatment

title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
code: library(LPEseq2)  set.seed(123)  counts <- matrix(   rnbinom(1000, mu = 50, size = 10),   nrow = 100,   ncol = 10 )  rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", 1:100) colnames(counts) <- paste0("sample", 1:10)  colData <- data.frame(   group = rep(c("Control", "Treatment"), each = 5),   row.names = colnames(counts) )  prep <- LPE_preprocess(   counts = counts,   colData = colData,   design = ~ group,   normalize.method = "library_size",   verbose = FALSE )  res <- LPE_ANOVA(   object = prep,   trim.method = "mad",   p.method = "chisq",   verbose = FALSE )  head(res)
